sloka: स्वर्गे ते सङ्गमो भूयो भविष्यति न संशयः ।अस्यास्तु परिषन्मध्ये यद्ब्रवीमि निबोध तत् ।। ७.९८.१५ ॥
transliteration: svarge te saṅgamo bhūyo bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ।asyāstu pariṣanmadhye yadbravīmi nibodha tat ।। 7.98.15 ॥

translations.english: There is no doubt that your union with her will happen again in heaven; but understand what I am about to tell you in the midst of this assembly.
